title: Twill: Scheduling Compound AI Systems on Heterogeneous Mobile Edge Platforms
problem: Compound AI systems chain multiple models (DNNs, transformers, LLMs) on mobile edge platforms with dynamic workloads and heterogeneous computational demands, challenging existing scheduling methods.
method: Run-time framework using task affinity-aware cluster mapping, priority-aware task freezing/unfreezing, and Dynamic Voltage/Frequency Scaling (DVFS) to minimize latency within power budgets.
key_novelty: First run-time framework for scheduling concurrent DNN-transformer-LLM inference on heterogeneous mobile edge platforms.
contributions: Task affinity-aware cluster mapping and migration
54% average latency reduction on Jetson Orin NX
primary_theme: Run-time scheduling for compound AI systems on mobile platforms
